entries.zh: 侵夺、强取（以侵凌手段夺取他人财物）
entries.en: to seize and take (by encroachment/force); to snatch away

entries.zh: 侵占、强占（占夺他人田产、财物）
entries.en: to occupy and usurp; to seize and hold by encroachment

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original largely missing; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 仅存汉字“唔脉”，西语、闽南语、官话三栏皆空；“唔”或为“无/毋”之借字，或与脉诊相关，无从定夺。

entries.zh: 诊脉、按脉（省察脉象；稿本并列 ua me／may me 两种说法）
entries.en: to take (feel) the pulse; to examine the pulse

entries.zh: 打了不带去（夺而不携）；句义存疑
entries.en: to strike and not carry off; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西语词头“tomolo y vulvempino”难解（或为 volverlo 之讹变），汉字“打不帶”与 pa-m-tva 可互证而整句语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: （禽鸟）踩踏、交配；相踏
entries.en: (of birds) to tread, to mate; to trample on one another
entries.notes: “tomarse las aves”取 17 世纪西语雄禽“踩踏”交配之义，与汉字“相踏”、闽南语 sio-ta 恰合，惟词头书写略有讹损，列中等置信。

entries.zh: （禽兽）交配合偶；相伴随行
entries.en: (of animals) to pair off, to mate; to go along together, accompany each other
entries.notes: “tomarse los animales”解作禽兽配合成双，与“相帶”sio-tvà（相互陪伴/相携）相应，系推断义。

entries.zh: 记诵、背诵于心（念着记住）
entries.en: to learn by heart, memorize; to recite

entries.zh: 做记号、记下备忘
entries.en: to make a note or mark; to jot down as a reminder

entries.zh: 紧握、攥牢（用手抓紧拿起）
entries.en: to grip firmly, to take with a clasp of the hand

entries.zh: 降火、去火（服清热降火之药）
entries.en: to reduce internal heat (“fire”); to take medicine to cool the fire

entries.zh: 考察、查究（对官员任内行为之清查审察，即西语殖民行政之“政绩审查”）
entries.en: to conduct a residencia (judicial inquiry into an office-holder's term); to inspect, investigate

entries.zh: 查究审断、察访判理
entries.en: to investigate and judge; to hold an inquiry

entries.zh: 攻劫、攻夺（国、城池）
entries.en: to conquer, to take (a kingdom) by assault; to attack and plunder

entries.zh: 生癣、长癣（皮肤生癣疾）
entries.en: to break out with ringworm/tinea (a skin eruption)
entries.notes: 西语词形“tomarse lecin”难辨；据“銑”借音“癣”（xiǎn 同音）与闽南语 se-sien 推断为“生癣”，西语所指无法确证。

entries.zh: 乘凉、纳凉
entries.en: to take the cool air, to enjoy the coolness/shade

entries.zh: 提起挪动、拿动
entries.en: to take up and move; to stir
entries.notes: 西语词头残损难解（auello 或为 aquello，spesa 不明），据汉字“提動”与闽南语 se-tang 定“拿起移动”义。

entries.zh: 是他的事、归他承担
entries.en: it is his business/charge; he takes it upon himself

entries.zh: 是我的事、归我承担
entries.en: it is my business; I take it upon myself

entries.zh: 那件事归我管、那是我的事
entries.en: that (matter) is my affair; I take charge of that

entries.zh: 取记号为凭、指认定标（字义未全解）
entries.en: to take a sign/token; to designate and fix
entries.notes: 汉字“提定”与闽南语 se-kia 对应不明，仅西语 tomar señal 明确，姑取“取信记/指定”之义。

entries.zh: 提进去、拿进去（掖在斗篷下带进去）
entries.en: to take it inside; to carry it (to them) hidden under one's cloak
